title: The Rising Tide
description: Something has corrupted the burial grounds near the Bandit Hideout, and the dead are rising in numbers Crossroads' handful of watchmen cannot hold and Thornfield's cemetery-keeper cannot bury fast enough. This is the greatest threat to the cycle you have faced. The Priest of Morthane sends you to find the source before the watch at Crossroads breaks and Thornfield loses its dead a second time.

objectives.description: Hold Crossroads' watch line against the first wave
Stop the shades before the cemetery-keeper loses the graves twice over
Follow the undead trail to the Bandit Hideout
Locate the corruption source in the hideout
Defeat the Death Knight commanding the undead army
Purify the corruption nexus with Morthane's flame
Return to the Priest of Morthane

notes: Threat: named against the audit's complaint - Crossroads' watch and Thornfield's cemetery-keeper stand in for the unnamed towns, giving each wave someone concrete to fail if the player doesn't hold. Giver motive: doctrinal escalation - this is the largest breach of the cycle the priest has sent the player against. Consequence: not wired.
